name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Original Moonbow (H)
description:
Sweet, colorful, and smooth as it gets. The Cheech & Chong Original Moonbow cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Original Moonbow brings a bright, layered profile: sweet mixed fruit and candy-berry notes up front, rounded out by a creamy, subtly gassy finish. Blended with a hybrid terpene profile for a balanced, easygoing feel — flavorful and mellow, comfortable at any hour.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Original Moonbow flavor — sweet mixed fruit and candy berry with a creamy finish
Hybrid terpene blend — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Original Moonbow is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
